findings.passage: “I am committed to advancing the gun violence prevention bills, Senate Bills 76 – 86, which focus on universal background checks, safe storage, and red flag laws. These comprehensive solutions will not take away firearms from responsible gun owners but will help to ensure that those who should not have a gun have a harder time getting one. ”
findings.note: Quoted statement in her office newsletter; the page does not print a name beside it, so it is read as hers from the newsletter's source. Covers SB 76-86 (background checks, safe storage, red flag).

provenance.fetched_by: source-collector

findings.passage: “I understand the importance of protecting the rights granted to us under the Second Amendment. For the first time in some 40 years, Democrats in the Michigan legislature hope to deliver on the promise of advancing gun safety. As your elected leader for Senate District 11, it is my responsibility to do what I can to help keep our kids and our communities safe, and that means acting on common-sense gun reforms.”
findings.note: Quote attributed to State Senator Veronica Klinefelt in her office newsletter, on the SB 76-86 gun package.

provenance.fetched_by: source-collector

findings.passage: My colleagues and I delivered a slate of gun violence prevention legislation that Michigan residents have waited years for. This legislation strengthens background checks, requires the secure storage of firearms, disarms individuals convicted of domestic violence and allows for the temporary removal of firearms from people who pose a significant risk to themselves or others.
findings.note: Her office newsletter, Gun Violence Awareness Month item, written in the first person; describes the 2023 package she supported.
